Plan Description: The Brookhaven FL is one of M/I Homes’ most desired home designs! With this Mediterranean-inspired, single-story home with a 3-car garage, you can choose from exteriors featuring a facade with full stone accent, oversized windows, or covered entry (each with lace stucco finish), as well as a brick paver driveway, and lead walk. Learn more today! On the inside, you will immediately notice the Brookhaven's large, open-concept, split-bedroom design. As you enter, you will experience a sense of arrival and immediately notice the panoramic view of the living areas, which separate the secondary rooms from the owner's suite. Destination rooms, like the living room, work well for those wanting a traditional home feel or the convenience of a home office. 11' ceilings cover the family and dining room with plenty of natural light. The family room and kitchen are eye-catching. The family room has a wall of oversized sliders that lead out to the massive covered lanai, making this home an entertainer's delight. On its own, the recessed covered lanai makes a great shady retreat for the backyard, and has plenty of space for an outdoor kitchen or living room. The owner's suite is a retreat of its own, with plenty of room for large bedroom sets or to create a relaxing sitting area. The en-suite bathroom has a gorgeous soaking tub centered in the middle, and there are also separate sink vanities, which are perfect for those busy mornings and add to the luxuriousness of the home. The owner's suite also has two large walk-in closets and a separate linen closet, offering plenty of storage space. The secondary rooms are located on the opposite side of the home, two of which share a Jack-and-Jill bathroom. A hall linen closet and pool bath are perfect for those days spent outdoors, as the bath leads directly out to the massive recessed lanai. Need more rooms? Choose the optional bonus room, with or without a bedroom/bathroom. Make this bonus room your favorite place to get your game on with the addition of the optional wet bar or second-floor balcony! All these features make the Brookhaven FL feel like a custom home. The possibilities are endless, and these are just some of the features that make this home a family favorite! The Brookhaven FL is an Energy Star® 3.1 Certified Home and is backed by M/I Homes’ 10-Year Transferable Structural Warranty. Contact us to learn more about making this home yours today!

Plan Description: The San Marino II FL is one of the largest, single-story, open-concept homes in the M/I Homes collection! This 3,400 square foot home offers 4 bedrooms, 3 ½ baths, and features a formal dining, living room, volume ceilings, and a 3-car garage with storage area per elevation. This plan features exterior elevations that offer architectural textures such as stone accent, raised columns, oversized windows, and lace stucco finish. The San Marino II feels like a custom home. On the inside, there is a dramatic entry foyer with 13’ tray ceilings, accented with archways and half walls that see through the formal living, dining, and family room. Combined with the volume 12’8” ceilings, this home has plenty of natural light. An open-concept kitchen with 42” cabinets, oversized kitchen island, walk-in pantry, and separate breakfast area, have panoramic views of the backyard and living areas. The family room and rear lanai almost appear as one. Separated by a “wall of glass” created by 2’8" transom windows on top of 8’ split-sliding glass doors the length of the family room that lead out to the covered lanai. This area is show stopping and possibly the envy of the neighborhood. There is even an extended lanai option for additional outdoor living space. The heart of the home divides the bedrooms as a true split plan: the one bedroom with its own bath in the front of the home, two additional bedrooms that share a hall bath (which would make a great pool bath as it comes with access to the backyard) on the other side of the home behind the kitchen, and the owner’s suite privately tucked away on the other side of the family room. All the secondary bedrooms have walk-in closet, keeping all the residents happy. The owner’s suite is pure luxury with a double door entry, tons of natural light, two large walk-in closets, and optional tray ceiling. The owner’s bath showcases a separate soaking tub and oversized walk-in shower, dual sink vanity, linen storage, and private water closet. A key drop area and mud room are out of sight, yet gives everyone easy access to all your devices, briefcases, backpacks, etc. The spacious laundry room is also hidden in this area, and has a window for natural light, as well as space for a utility sink. A half bath is tucked away for guests to use. An oversized, second-floor bonus room, as well as a bedroom and full bath, can be added for additional space. This floorplan is perfect if you often have extended stay guests, require a home/work space, or for multi-generational living. This stunning home is built to Energy Star® 3.1 building standards for energy efficiency and is backed by M/I Homes’ 10-Year Transferable Structural Warranty. Contact us today to learn more!

Plan Description: The Brookhaven FL is one of M/I Homes’ most desired home designs! With this Mediterranean-inspired, single-story home , you can choose from exteriors featuring a facade with full stone accent, oversized windows, or covered entry (each with lace stucco finish), as well as a brick paver driveway, and lead walk. Learn more today! On the inside, you will immediately notice the Brookhaven's large, open-concept, split-bedroom design. As you enter, you will experience a sense of arrival and immediately notice the panoramic view of the living areas, which separate the secondary rooms from the owner's suite. Destination rooms, like the living room, work well for those wanting a traditional home feel or the convenience of a home office. 11' ceilings cover the family and dining room with plenty of natural light. The family room and kitchen are eye-catching. The family room has a wall of oversized sliders that lead out to the massive covered lanai, making this home an entertainer's delight. On its own, the recessed covered lanai makes a great shady retreat for the backyard, and has plenty of space for an outdoor kitchen or living room. The owner's suite is a retreat of its own, with plenty of room for large bedroom sets or to create a relaxing sitting area. The en-suite bathroom has a gorgeous soaking tub centered in the middle, and there are also separate sink vanities, which are perfect for those busy mornings and add to the luxuriousness of the home. The owner's suite also has two large walk-in closets and a separate linen closet, offering plenty of storage space. The secondary rooms are located on the opposite side of the home, two of which share a Jack-and-Jill bathroom. A hall linen closet and pool bath are perfect for those days spent outdoors, as the bath leads directly out to the massive recessed lanai. Need more rooms? Choose the optional bonus room, with or without a bedroom/bathroom. Make this bonus room your favorite place to get your game on with the addition of the optional wet bar or second-floor balcony! All these features make the Brookhaven FL feel like a custom home. The possibilities are endless, and these are just some of the features that make this home a family favorite! The Brookhaven FL is an Energy Star® 3.1 Certified Home and is backed by M/I Homes’ 10-Year Transferable Structural Warranty. Contact us to learn more about making this home yours today!

Plan Description: The Tradewinds FL, brings to mind living a lifestyle of relaxing in the breeze and is the perfect home to build! This 2-story, 4-5 bedroom home has been designed to bring the outdoors inside with its abundance of windows, sliding glass doors, lanai, and balconies that are available to enhance your love for the outdoors. In addition, there are quite a few areas that are great for entertaining friends and family, or just for your own private enjoyment. You can choose from Mediterranean-, craftsman-, or contemporary-style exterior elevations. From the double door entry, you notice the openness of the first floor. This floor features a den, under-stairwell storage, an open dining room framed with columns, and a panoramic kitchen that looks out to the family room – you'll be so excited to make this home yours! The rear of the home features three sets of 8' sliding glass doors out to the 33' long lanai. You'll enjoy the convenience and privacy away from the others rooms in your first-floor owner's suite. This 18' x 19' owner's suite features a three large windows that face the rear of the home. There is an optional extended lanai with French doors from the owner's suite as well. The owner's bathroom is truly spa-inspired, and offers you dual walk-in closets, dual separate vanities, a separate shower, and a stand-alone vessel bath tub – perfect for starting or ending your day! The first-floor laundry room is located conveniently near the owner's suite. Three secondary bedrooms and two bathrooms make up the second floor. A large storage area is great for seasonal items, or for the hobbyist of the home. If you are looking for more room in the loft, opt for the second-floor balcony or extended loft. You can also choose an optional fifth bedroom and fourth bathroom in lieu of the den and storage. This home is built to Energy Star 3.1 standards and is third party verified. Each home is also backed by M/I Homes' 10- Year Transferable Structural Warranty. For more information on this home or the community contact us today!

Plan Description: You'll fall in love with the Tradewinds FL, as it brings to mind living a lifestyle of relaxing in the breeze and is the perfect home to build! This 2-story, 4-5 bedroom home has been designed to bring the outdoors inside with its abundance of windows, sliding glass doors, lanai, and balconies that are available to enhance your love for the outdoors. Plan Description: A charming covered porch welcomes you as you approach the entrance to this grand two story home. Once inside, a formal, open dining room awaits with convenient access to the kitchen. Just past the stairs, you will find the kitchen and eat-in cafe that seamlessly connects to the family room, creating a central living space for family gatherings. The kitchen boasts an oversized island, abundant cabinet space, and a large walk-in pantry. There's even an option for a butler's pantry to service the dining room when hosting special dinners for family and friends. The quaint kitchen cafe opens to the covered lanai via sliding glass doors, but you can choose to expand the outdoor space for added entertaining options with a sunroom and additional lanai space. The garage entrance just of the kitchen is perfectly located for easy grocery drop off and features a key drop to drop the purse and keys. Downstairs you’ll find a bedroom and full bath with the option to upgrade it to an owner’s bedroom with private bath featuring an oversized shower, dual vanity, and a pool bath servicing the main living space. A powder bath can be added by the entrance if desired. When you arrive to the second floor from the stairs located by the front door, there is the loft, which is a great place for a pool table, family movie night, or game night. You will find all of the bedrooms situated in the corners. Adjacent to the loft is the owner’s suite – its placement at the back of the home not only makes it private, but the windows provide a great view of the backyard. Separate vanities, a private commode area, linen closet, and a generous walk-in closet make up your owner’s bath, your personal retreat for unwinding and relaxing. A free standing vessel tub can be added to complete your home spa area. Picture the entertaining you can do with this amazing optional space! On the other side of the stairs, towards the front of the home, are three bedrooms that share a hall bathroom with an optional dual sink vanity and additional linen storage. You can opt for the addition of a fourth bath in the second bedroom. The laundry room is upstairs right by the bedrooms. Best of all, this is a high performance home! It is Energy Star 3.1 certified, which means it is affordable to operate and you can save money on your energy bills. Some of the energy saving features include Core Fill insulation in the block walls, Radiant Roof Barrier, R-38 ceiling insulation, Low-E double pane windows, and Energy Star appliances.

Plan Description: The San Marino II FL is one of the largest, single-story, open-concept homes in the M/I Homes collection! This 3,400 square foot home offers 4 bedrooms, 3 ½ baths, and features a formal dining, living room, volume ceilings, and a 3-car garage with storage area per elevation. This plan features exterior elevations that offer architectural textures such as stone accent, raised columns, oversized windows, and lace stucco finish. The San Marino II feels like a custom home. On the inside, there is a dramatic entry foyer with 13’ tray ceilings, accented with archways and half walls that see through the formal living, dining, and family room. Combined with the volume 13’ 4” ceilings, this home has plenty of natural light. An open-concept kitchen with 42” cabinets, oversized kitchen island, walk-in pantry, and separate breakfast area, have panoramic views of the backyard and living areas. The family room and rear lanai almost appear as one. Separated by a “wall of glass” created by 2’8" transom windows on top of 8’ split-sliding glass doors the length of the family room that lead out to the covered lanai. This area is show stopping and possibly the envy of the neighborhood. There is even an extended lanai option for additional outdoor living space. The heart of the home divides the bedrooms as a true split plan: the one bedroom with its own bath in the front of the home, two additional bedrooms that share a hall bath (which would make a great pool bath as it comes with access to the backyard) on the other side of the home behind the kitchen, and the owner’s suite privately tucked away on the other side of the family room. All the secondary bedrooms have walk-in closet, keeping all the residents happy. The owner’s suite is pure luxury with a double door entry, tons of natural light, two large walk-in closets, and optional tray ceiling. The owner’s bath showcases a oversized walk-in shower, dual sink vanity, and private water closet. Opt to add the free-standing vessel tub for the ultimate in home spa vibes. A key drop area and mud room are out of sight, yet gives everyone easy access to all your devices, briefcases, backpacks, etc. The spacious laundry room is also hidden in this area, and has a window for natural light, as well as space for a utility sink. A half bath is tucked away for guests to use. An oversized, second-floor bonus room, as well as a bedroom and full bath, can be added for additional space. This floorplan is perfect if you often have extended stay guests, require a home/work space, or for multi-generational living. This stunning home is built with energy efficiency in mind and is backed by M/I Homes’ 10-Year Transferable Structural Warranty. Contact us today to learn more!

Plan Description: A charming covered porch welcomes you as you approach the entrance to this grand two story home. Once inside, a formal, open dining room awaits with convenient access to the kitchen. Just past the stairs, you will find the kitchen and eat-in cafe that seamlessly connects to the family room, creating a central living space for family gatherings. The kitchen boasts an oversized island, abundant cabinet space, and a large walk-in pantry. There's even an option for a butler's pantry to service the dining room when hosting special dinners for family and friends. The quaint kitchen cafe opens to the covered lanai via sliding glass doors, but you can choose to expand the outdoor space for added entertaining options with a sunroom and additional lanai space. The garage entrance just of the kitchen is perfectly located for easy grocery drop off and features a key drop to drop the purse and keys. Downstairs you’ll find a bedroom and full bath with the option to upgrade it to an owner’s bedroom with private bath featuring an oversized shower, dual vanity, and a pool bath servicing the main living space. A powder bath can be added by the entrance if desired. When you arrive to the second floor from the stairs located by the front door, there is the loft, which is a great place for a pool table, family movie night, or game night. You will find all of the bedrooms situated in the corners. Adjacent to the loft is the owner’s suite – its placement at the back of the home not only makes it private, but the windows provide a great view of the backyard. Separate vanities, a private commode area, linen closet, and a generous walk-in closet make up your owner’s bath, your personal retreat for unwinding and relaxing. A free standing vessel tub can be added to complete your home spa area. Picture the entertaining you can do with this amazing optional space! On the other side of the stairs, towards the front of the home, are three bedrooms that share a hall bathroom with an optional dual sink vanity and additional linen storage. You can opt for the addition of a fourth bath in the second bedroom. The laundry room is upstairs right by the bedrooms. Best of all, this is a high performance home! It is Energy Star 3.1 certified, which means it is affordable to operate and you can save money on your energy bills. Some of the energy saving features include Core Fill insulation in the block walls, Radiant Roof Barrier, R-38 ceiling insulation, Low-E double pane windows, and Energy Star appliances.

Plan Description: The San Marino II FL is one of the largest, single-story, open-concept homes in the M/I Homes collection! This 3,400 square foot home offers 4 bedrooms, 3 ½ baths, and features a formal dining, living room, volume ceilings, and a 3-car garage with storage area per elevation. This plan features exterior elevations that offer architectural textures such as stone accent, raised columns, oversized windows, and lace stucco finish. The San Marino II feels like a custom home. On the inside, there is a dramatic entry foyer with 13’ tray ceilings, accented with archways and half walls that see through the formal living, dining, and family room. Combined with the volume 12’8” ceilings, this home has plenty of natural light. An open-concept kitchen with 42” cabinets, oversized kitchen island, walk-in pantry, and separate breakfast area, have panoramic views of the backyard and living areas. The family room and rear lanai almost appear as one. Separated by a “wall of glass” created by 2’8" transom windows on top of 8’ split-sliding glass doors the length of the family room that lead out to the covered lanai. This area is show stopping and possibly the envy of the neighborhood. There is even an extended lanai option for additional outdoor living space. The heart of the home divides the bedrooms as a true split plan: the one bedroom with its own bath in the front of the home, two additional bedrooms that share a hall bath (which would make a great pool bath as it comes with access to the backyard) on the other side of the home behind the kitchen, and the owner’s suite privately tucked away on the other side of the family room. All the secondary bedrooms have walk-in closet, keeping all the residents happy. The owner’s suite is pure luxury with a double door entry, tons of natural light, two large walk-in closets, and optional tray ceiling. The owner’s bath showcases a separate soaking tub and oversized walk-in shower, dual sink vanity, linen storage, and private water closet. A key drop area and mud room are out of sight, yet gives everyone easy access to all your devices, briefcases, backpacks, etc. The spacious laundry room is also hidden in this area, and has a window for natural light, as well as space for a utility sink. A half bath is tucked away for guests to use. An oversized, second-floor bonus room, as well as a bedroom and full bath, can be added for additional space. This floorplan is perfect if you often have extended stay guests, require a home/work space, or for multi-generational living. This stunning home is built to Energy Star® 3.1 building standards for energy efficiency and is backed by M/I Homes’ 10-Year Transferable Structural Warranty. Contact us today to learn more!

Plan Description: One of our most popular floorplans, the Tradewinds SL, brings to mind living a lifestyle of relaxation in the breeze! This 2-story, 4–5-bedroom home has been designed to bring the outdoors inside with its abundance of windows, sliding glass doors, lanai, and balconies, which are available to enhance your love for the outdoors. In addition, there are quite a few areas that are great for entertaining when having friends and family, as well as just their private enjoyment. You can choose from Mediterranean-, craftsman-, or contemporary-inspired exterior elevations, all of which have 3-car, side-load garages. From the double-door entry, you notice the openness of the first floor. Featuring a den, under-stairwell storage, an open dining room framed with columns, and a panoramic kitchen that looks out to the family room, you'll be eager to make this home yours. The rear of the home features three sets of 8' sliding glass doors out to 33' long lanai. With a first-floor owner's suite, you enjoy privacy away from all the other bedrooms in the home. The 18' x 19' owner's suite features a three large windows that face the rear of the home. There is also an optional extended lanai with French doors from the owner's suite. The owner's bath is truly spa-inspired, and offers the homeowners dual walk-in closets, dual separate vanities, a separate shower and bath tub, making for the perfect stress-free area for ending and starting your day! The first-floor laundry room is located conveniently away from the bedrooms. Three secondary bedrooms, and two bathrooms make up the second floor. A large storage area is great for seasonal items or the hobbyist of the home. If you are looking for more room in the loft, opt for the second-floor balcony or extended loft. On the first floor, you can also add an optional fifth bedroom and fourth bath in lieu of the den and storage. For more information on this home or the community contact us today!

Plan Description: Welcome home to one of our newest plans, the Lancaster. This compact but mighty floorplan delivers 5 bedrooms and 3 baths, a loft, and a 3-car garage but can be upgraded to have 6 bedrooms and 4 baths if desired! Enjoy three different façades with features ranging from faux shutters for a pop of color, to engineered stone for texture, or shaker shingles for depth. No matter which one you select, they all offer a covered porch at the angled entry door. Upon entry, you’ll delight in the openness of the first floor, taking in panoramic views of the dining room, family room, and kitchen. The formal dining room, accented with drywall columns, offers direct access to the kitchen, making serving your guest at your next party a breeze. Opt for adding two additional side windows if you like. If formal spaces aren’t your thing, choose the den option, and enclose the space with a double door, creating the perfect home office or library. The kitchen has an expansive island with seating, which is sure to be the gathering place of family and friends. Centrally located, from this spot you can see it all. Ample cabinetry, a corner walk-in pantry, and GE® appliances insure a happy home chef. The family room showcases three large rear-facing windows to take in your backyard views, while access to the patio is through a sliding glass door off the breakfast nook. Take advantage of one of the two covered lanai options; the 12’x8’ or the go big with the 28’x8’ option. You’ll find a bedroom with a generous walk-in closet and a full bath downstairs, making a nice guest suite. This bathroom can be upgraded to a walk-in shower if a tub/shower combo isn’t to your liking. The storage closet under the stairs is a welcomed space, whether for boxes, a wine room, or a Harry Potter play space for the kids. Here, in this hall, you can opt for adding another deep storage closet or a powder bath, both great options. Head upstairs, where you’ll find the rest of the bedrooms, perfectly situated with one in each corner, optimizing the resident’s privacy. A hall bath, linen closet, and the laundry room are all centrally located for ease of use. One of the bedrooms can be upgraded to include its own en-suite bath, creating a mini-owner’s suite. The loft, a great second hang out spot for the family, offers an optional tray ceiling. This space can be closed in and made into a 6 th bedroom if you desire. The owner’s suite, tucked privately in a back corner, is separated by the laundry room and a walk-in closet on one side and it’s own bath on the other, so it doesn’t share any walls with other bedrooms. Two rear-facing windows will frame your bed while the optional tray ceiling can offer some added volume and elegance to the space. The owner’s bath showcases another walk-in closet, a linen closet, enclosed water closet, separate vanities, and a large walk-in shower. The corner-mounted, free-standing vessel tub option takes this bath over the top. How about unwinding after a long day in this beauty? Can you say home spa?! All that, and the Lancaster is an Energy Star® 3.1 certified home and is backed by our 10 -Year Transferable Structural Warranty Commitment. We invite you to come explore what could ultimately be your dream home. Contact us today to schedule a tour!

Plan Description: This gorgeous 4-6 bedroom, 3-4 bath, with den, and 3-car tandem garage home offers exceptional design with plenty of space for entertaining family and friends. This single-story home offers just over 3,000 square feet of living space, with the ability to increase it to 3,859 if needed to accommodate your family’s needs. From the minute you enter through the 8’ front door, you experience a sense of arrival. The elegant foyer and formal dining room each offer a tray ceiling for added elegance. The open-concept family room and gorgeous kitchen are an entertainer's delight, keeping everyone engaged within the same area. 9’ wide sliding glass doors in the family room lead to the covered lanai where the fun can continue and memories can be made. Access to the lanai from the owner’s suite and/or from bedroom 3 is possible if you like as well. The chef’s kitchen has tons of storage with 42” cabinets, a 9’ island, and huge walk-in pantry. You’ll find an additional storage closet just off the kitchen, and the ability to add a butler’s pantry on the way to the dining room. A breakfast nook is conveniently located just off the kitchen, keeping serving meals a breeze. The owner’s suite is a retreat of its own with three large rear facing windows bringing in the natural light, a nice-sized walk-in closet, and the ability to add a tray ceiling. Through double doors, enter the owner’s bath, and enjoy the oversized shower, two separate vanities, a linen closet, and a private water closet. Bring the spa home by adding the optional free-standing tub. Need never more space? Opt for the “super master” option and increase the length of the owner’s suite by 5 feet and gain a walk-in closet the size of a bedroom with plenty of hanging space and storage. Two secondary bedrooms share a hall bath on the other side of the home behind the kitchen, while a fourth bedroom delivers its own en-suite bath, perfect for guests. The den, off the foyer, can be made into an additional bedroom if more rooms is what you are looking for. Does your family situation call for a second owner’s suite? This might be the plan for you! The front bedroom and den can be combined to create a full second owner’s suite, complete with walk-in closet and a bath with a large shower, dual sinks, and enclosed water closet. Looking for even more space? Add the optional spacious bonus room which comes with a large storage closet. You can further opt for another bathroom or another bedroom with a full bath. The covered balcony is a must-add option if you’re considering a homesite with a view.

Plan Description: Welcome home to one of our newest plans, the Lancaster. This compact but mighty floorplan delivers 5 bedrooms and 3 baths, a loft, and a 3-car garage but can be upgraded to have 6 bedrooms and 4 baths if desired! Enjoy three different façades with features ranging from faux shutters for a pop of color, to engineered stone for texture, or shaker shingles for depth. No matter which one you select, they all offer a covered porch at the angled entry door. Upon entry, you’ll delight in the openness of the first floor, taking in panoramic views of the dining room, family room, and kitchen. The formal dining room, accented with drywall columns, offers direct access to the kitchen, making serving your guest at your next party a breeze. Opt for adding two additional side windows if you like. If formal spaces aren’t your thing, choose the den option, and enclose the space with a double door, creating the perfect home office or library. The kitchen has an expansive island with seating, which is sure to be the gathering place of family and friends. Centrally located, from this spot you can see it all. Ample cabinetry, a corner walk-in pantry, and GE® appliances insure a happy home chef. The family room showcases three large rear-facing windows to take in your backyard views, while access to the patio is through a sliding glass door off the breakfast nook. Take advantage of one of the two covered lanai options; the 12’x8’ or the go big with the 28’x8’ option. You’ll find a bedroom with a generous walk-in closet and a full bath downstairs, making a nice guest suite. This bathroom can be upgraded to a walk-in shower if a tub/shower combo isn’t to your liking. The storage closet under the stairs is a welcomed space, whether for boxes, a wine room, or a Harry Potter play space for the kids. Here, in this hall, you can opt for adding another deep storage closet or a powder bath, both great options. Head upstairs, where you’ll find the rest of the bedrooms, perfectly situated with one in each corner, optimizing the resident’s privacy. A hall bath, linen closet, and the laundry room are all centrally located for ease of use. One of the bedrooms can be upgraded to include its own en-suite bath, creating a mini-owner’s suite. The loft, a great second hang out spot for the family, offers an optional tray ceiling. This space can be closed in and made into a 6 th bedroom if you desire. The owner’s suite, tucked privately in a back corner, is separated by the laundry room and a walk-in closet on one side and it’s own bath on the other, so it doesn’t share any walls with other bedrooms. Two rear-facing windows will frame your bed while the optional tray ceiling can offer some added volume and elegance to the space. The owner’s bath showcases another walk-in closet, a linen closet, enclosed water closet, separate vanities, and a large walk-in shower. The corner-mounted, free-standing vessel tub option takes this bath over the top. How about unwinding after a long day in this beauty? Can you say home spa?! We invite you to come explore what could ultimately be your dream home. Contact us today to schedule a tour!

Plan Description: Welcome home to the Lancaster. This compact but mighty floorplan delivers 5 bedrooms and 3 baths, a loft, and a 3-car garage but can be upgraded to have 6 bedrooms and 4 baths if desired! Enjoy three different façades with features ranging from faux shutters for a pop of color, to engineered stone for texture, or shaker shingles for depth. No matter which one you select, they all offer a covered porch at the angled entry door. Upon entry, you’ll delight in the openness of the first floor, taking in panoramic views of the dining room, family room, and kitchen. The formal dining room, accented with drywall columns, offers direct access to the kitchen, making serving your guest at your next party a breeze. Opt for adding two additional side windows if you like. If formal spaces aren’t your thing, choose the den option, and enclose the space with a double door, creating the perfect home office or library. The kitchen has an expansive island with seating, which is sure to be the gathering place of family and friends. Centrally located, from this spot you can see it all. Ample cabinetry, a corner walk-in pantry, and GE® appliances insure a happy home chef. The family room showcases three large rear-facing windows to take in your backyard views, while access to the patio is through a sliding glass door off the breakfast nook. Take advantage of one of the two covered lanai options; the 12’x8’ or the go big with the 28’x8’ option. You’ll find a bedroom with a generous walk-in closet and a full bath downstairs, making a nice guest suite. This bathroom can be upgraded to a walk-in shower if a tub/shower combo isn’t to your liking. The storage closet under the stairs is a welcomed space, whether for boxes, a wine room, or a Harry Potter play space for the kids. Here, in this hall, you can opt for adding another deep storage closet or a powder bath, both great options. Head upstairs, where you’ll find the rest of the bedrooms, perfectly situated with one in each corner, optimizing the resident’s privacy. A hall bath, linen closet, and the laundry room are all centrally located for ease of use. One of the bedrooms can be upgraded to include its own en-suite bath, creating a mini-owner’s suite. The loft, a great second hang out spot for the family, offers an optional tray ceiling. This space can be closed in and made into a 6 th bedroom if you desire. The owner’s suite, tucked privately in a back corner, is separated by the laundry room and a walk-in closet on one side and it’s own bath on the other, so it doesn’t share any walls with other bedrooms. Two rear-facing windows will frame your bed while the optional tray ceiling can offer some added volume and elegance to the space. The owner’s bath showcases another walk-in closet, a linen closet, enclosed water closet, separate vanities, and a large walk-in shower. The corner-mounted, free-standing vessel tub option takes this bath over the top. How about unwinding after a long day in this beauty? Can you say home spa?! All that, and the Lancaster is an Energy Star® 3.1 certified home and is backed by our 10 -Year Transferable Structural Warranty Commitment. We invite you to come explore what could ultimately be your dream home. Contact us today to schedule a tour!

Plan Description: The Huntington floorplan offers open-concept living at its finest! Pick from three different front elevations: varying roof lines for added appeal, faux shutters for a pop of color, or engineered stone for added texture. There’s no wrong decision! This single-story, 3-bedroom, split floorplan gives you a sense of arrival with tall ceilings at the foyer, which offers an optional tray ceiling, leading you to soaring vaulted ceilings at the heart of the home. Entertain your guests from the fabulous angled kitchen island, which opens to the family room, dining room, and breakfast nook. The covered lanai, which is accessed through a triple sliding glass door off the nook, is sure to be a favorite place to enjoy the Florida weather. If building your home from scratch, you can choose the extended lanai option, which extends this space an additional 4 feet. The spacious owner’s suite, with the option to add a tray ceiling for added volume, features his-and-hers closets, and an en-suite bath with a double-sink vanity, a large shower, an enclosed water closet, and a linen closet. If you are more of a bath person, check out the deluxe owner’s bath, which adds a soaking tub under the window. Two secondary bedrooms, one featuring a walk-in closet, are located in the front of the home, allowing guest and residents privacy from the owner’s suite. The bathroom, with the option for a second sink, boasts a linen closet and is accessed from the hall. The destination laundry room is centrally located by the garage entrance. A laundry tub can be added to the garage to make cleaning up after your home projects a little easier. Best of all, the Huntington is 100% Energy Star® 3.1, which means it’s affordable to operate and you can save money on your energy bills. Some of the energy saving features include Core-Fill™ R-9 insulation in the block walls, R-38 ceiling insulation, radiant roof barrier, and Low-E double pane windows. Enjoy peace of mind with M/I Homes 10-Year Warranty Commitment. To learn more about this home, schedule your personal tour today!

Plan Description: The Santa Barbara II is one of our most flexible and affordable two-story plans. The exterior of this home features varying roof pitch lines, lace stucco banding, gables, and accent banding. Choose between our elevations that include either stone accent, faux shutters, or a front porch. Once inside, on the first floor, the guests and family are greeted at large open foyer and flex room. The flex room can be used as a study, den, or formal space or choose the guest room option which close the room in and changes the powder bath to a full bath. As you enter the family room, you will take notice of the panoramic views of the kitchen, breakfast nook, and backyard. This space makes up the full rear portion of the home, making this area spacious enough for day to day living or special gatherings. You will love the L-shaped kitchen with a window above the sink and centrally located island. This kitchen also features GE® appliances, ample banks of cabinetry, a pantry, and plenty of counter space for prepping for your favorite meals. A key drop, located by the entry door from the garage, is the perfect spot to drop the keys, purse, and mail as you enter. Downstairs is complete with a deep storage closet off the foyer. The stairwell to the upstairs features plant shelving and is hidden from the entry to the home. Upstairs, the loft area is great for a second family room, game room, or you can opt for the 4th bedroom option.
